source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Development phase (PDF 8-9).

blocks.text: Development phase mein software asal mein banna shuru hota hai. Yahan programmers code likhte hain. Code hidayaat (instructions) ka woh set hai jis par chal kar computer khaas kaam karta hai. Design specifications (tafseel) batati hain ke software ko kya karna hai aur kaisa dikhna hai; programmers in specifications ko kisi programming language mein likh dete hain.

Ise recipe par chalne jaisa samjhein: design specifications recipe hain, aur coding cake banane ke liye cheezein milana aur bake karna hai. Code ki har line recipe ke ek step jaisi hai, jo yaqeeni banati hai ke software theek (correctly) kaam kare aur design ki requirements poori kare. Is phase mein programmers apna code test bhi karte hain ta ke errors ya bugs (ghaltiyan) dhoond kar theek karein. Is testing se software tawaqqo ke mutabiq chalta hai aur ghaltiyon se paak hota hai. Agar koi masla mile to programmers code badalte hain, masla theek karte hain aur dobara test karte hain, jab tak software agli stage ke liye tayyar na ho jaye.

blocks.prompt: Development phase mein programmers code likhne ke ilawa aur kya karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Woh apna code test karte hain, errors aur bugs dhoond kar theek karte hain, aur code badal kar dobara test karte hain jab tak software agli stage (testing) ke liye tayyar na ho jaye.

items: Development: programmers design specifications ko programming language ke code mein likhte hain (recipe se cake).
Is ke saath apna code test karte, bugs theek karte aur dobara test karte hain.
